Earlier reports indicated that WhatsApp was developing a new conversation theme feature, and this feature has now begun rolling out to iPhone users. Here are the details.

WhatsApp's new conversation themes include animated wallpapers

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is now launching five new conversation theme categories: Featured, Nature, Animated, Minimal and Doodle. Two weeks ago, the website first discovered information related to the new theme gallery within the app's code.

The website pointed out that the "Featured" category includes the "best themes" carefully selected by the WhatsApp design team; the "Nature" category "brings outdoor scenery into the conversation screen"; the "Animated" category "provides wallpapers that move slowly in the background"; the "Minimal" theme "applies a solid colour background to the conversation screen: white in light mode, black in dark mode". As for "Doodle", it includes WhatsApp's classic wallpapers featuring doodle patterns.

Below is WABetaInfo's introduction to "Animated" wallpapers, which can be said to be the most eye-catching new feature:

WABetaInfo mentioned that WhatsApp will automatically match the colour of the conversation bubbles based on the selected theme, and added that, as with the rollout of other WhatsApp features, the new feature may not be immediately available to all users.

To read WABetaInfo's full report, you can click this link.
